claims.question: q1
claims.claim: LLMs are deployed with persistent personalized context such as accumulated memory profiles or long conversation histories that are shared across a user's requests.
claims.quote: Large language models are increasingly deployed with persistent personalized context, such as accumulated memory profiles or long conversation histories, that is shared across a user's many requests.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: Production memory systems including Mem0, MemGPT, and Zep retrieve a relevant subset of memory and inject it into the prompt, causing repeated prefilling of the same content.
claims.quote: Production memory systems (e.g., Mem0, MemGPT, and Zep) retrieve a relevant subset of this memory and inject it into the prompt, forcing the serving engine to repeatedly prefill the same content.

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: As the retrieval budget grows, time-to-first-token increases even though the underlying memory is reused across requests.
claims.quote: As the retrieval budget grows, time-to-first-token (TTFT) increases even though the underlying memory is reused across requests.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: InferScale precomputes each memory fact's KV representation, stores it with a semantic embedding on the GPU, retrieves relevant facts at serving time, and injects their KV directly into vLLM's paged cache.
claims.quote: InferScale precomputes each memory fact's KV representation, stores it alongside a semantic embedding on the GPU, retrieves relevant facts at serving time, and injects their KV directly into vLLM's paged cache.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: Chunked RoPE stores keys before rotation and applies their serving-time positions during injection to support dynamically assembled memories under rotary position embeddings.
claims.quote: To support dynamically assembled memories under rotary position embeddings, we introduce Chunked RoPE, which stores keys before rotation and applies their serving-time positions during injection.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: Context-Window Encoding encodes each memory fact with a small window of preceding conversation context while caching only the target fact's KV.
claims.quote: We mitigate this with Context-Window Encoding, which encodes each memory fact together with a small window of preceding conversation context while caching only the target fact's KV.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Across three open-weight models on LoCoMo, at k=50 InferScale reduces TTFT by 72-79% (3.6-4.8x), achieves 60.3% accuracy versus 63.3% for Mem0 without serving-time recomputation, and delivers 3.7-4.5x throughput under concurrent load.
claims.quote: Across three open-weight models on LoCoMo, InferScale keeps TTFT nearly constant as the retrieval budget increases: at k=50 it reduces TTFT by 72-79% (3.6-4.8x), achieves 60.3% accuracy versus 63.3% for Mem0 without serving-time recomputation, and delivers 3.7-4.5x the throughput under concurrent load.

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: Reusable KV state decouples memory-conditioned serving latency from retrieved-context size while preserving application quality.
claims.quote: Reusable KV state thus decouples memory-conditioned serving latency from retrieved-context size while preserving application quality.
